title.narrative: Transforming the Education Sector for Better Outcomes and Results (TRESOR)

description.narrative: The proposed operation will address key constraints in the education system that are preventing the Republic of Congo from providing a quality education to all. Removing these constraints is expected to improve access to a quality basic education within the context of a strengthened, better-managed education system. Achieving this outcome will require a mix of policy reforms, resources, and capacity building in the areas of early childhood education, foundational learning, equity and inclusion, learning environments, teacher policy, national assessment, and education management and information systems. The country's Education Sector Strategy 2021-2030 will provide the main policy and financing frameworks for the targeted areas.
To (i) improve access to quality basic education and (ii) strengthen education sector management systems.
